verdict.rationale: Each skill is a plain, readable SKILL.md folder with frontmatter that a developer can inspect before installing, and the installer itself prompts 'Review skills before use' (probe-rt-1). The writing-skills skill frames skills as documentation (docs-15, docs-76), and using-superpowers documents some activation routing, e.g. 'Fix this bug' → systematic-debugging first (docs-77, docs-16). Skills auto-trigger without explicit invocation (gh-11), and a skills-search tool aids discovery (docs-20). missing for 10: evidence that every skill's frontmatter or description states its trigger conditions (the probe shows only a name field), a consolidated per-skill catalog of activation behavior, and independent corroboration that activation is predictable in practice.
